output.headerText:
This file is a Repomix pack of the repository 'Augmented_Investment_Pipeline' (AI-Augmented Investment Pipeline).

WHAT IT IS
An evidence-grounded seed-stage investment triage pipeline (Python 3.12+, uv). Given a topic, a YC batch, or a URL list, it discovers 10-20 startups (YC via the yc-oss index + Hacker News), collects cited public evidence per company (YC profile, company website, HN, optional Tavily), runs one evidence-constrained structured LLM analysis, applies a YAML-configured thesis, computes a deterministic 0-100 score in Python, and renders one-page Markdown memos with PASS/WATCH/TAKE_A_MEETING.

HOW TO VERIFY LOCALLY
- uv sync && uv run pytest          (31 offline tests)
- uv run ruff check src tests
- uv run pipeline run --topic "AI agents for SMBs"
- uv run pipeline eval              (static eval cases; --live for LLM-backed)

WHERE TO LOOK
- src/investment_pipeline/models.py       - all typed schemas (Evidence is the heart)
- src/investment_pipeline/sourcing/       - deterministic discovery (BM25, dedupe, ranking)
- src/investment_pipeline/research/       - evidence collection with provenance
- src/investment_pipeline/analysis/       - evidence-constrained prompt, validator, analyzers
- src/investment_pipeline/scoring/        - deterministic score + recommendation gate
- process/                                - real decision log and AI work log
- thesis/, prompts/, evals/               - thesis config, versioned prompts, eval cases

KNOWN SCOPE CUTS (deliberate)
No frontend, no database, no queues, no vector store, no agent frameworks.
Filesystem artifacts are the data store. Sample run (outputs/) is excluded from this pack.
